name: Monteiro Ramalho - 03.11 - Manutenção: campos de LinkedIn no banco

parameters.query:
alter table public.leads_tributario
  add column if not exists linkedin_status text,
  add column if not exists linkedin_provider_id text,
  add column if not exists linkedin_convite_em timestamptz,
  add column if not exists linkedin_conectado_em timestamptz,
  add column if not exists linkedin_erro text;

create index if not exists leads_tributario_linkedin_provider_id_idx
  on public.leads_tributario (linkedin_provider_id);

select
  (select string_agg(column_name, ', ' order by column_name) from information_schema.columns where table_schema = 'public' and table_name = 'leads_tributario' and column_name like 'linkedin%') as colunas_linkedin,
  (select count(*) from public.leads_tributario) as total_leads,
  (select count(*) from public.leads_tributario where coalesce(linkedin_url, '') <> '') as leads_com_linkedin;

nodes.name: Cria campos de LinkedIn em leads_tributario

parameters.content:
### Manutenção (rodar uma vez)
Cria os campos de controle do LinkedIn na tabela leads_tributario. Seguro rodar de novo: só cria o que não existe.
